title: Full Moon in Scorpio
tldr: A culmination and release point for the Scorpio / Taurus axis.
theme: This Full Moon illuminates depth, trust, release, intimacy, shared resources, and honest transformation through the Scorpio side of the axis, while the Sun in Taurus asks for integration rather than extremes.
shadow: control disguised as strength, testing people instead of telling the truth, or holding on until it hurts
integration: letting what is expired complete so real intimacy has room

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc exposes where accepting less has been disguised as patience.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Name what the last two weeks revealed. Release the pattern that blocks the Scorpio / Taurus balance point.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Look back to the same-sign New Moon. What took root because you tended it, and what grew because the soil was left untended?

ritual.function: illumination, release, cleansing, integration, and completion
ritual.timing: Use after the exact Full Moon when possible. Keep eclipse lunations under the separate witness protocol, not ordinary release ritual.
ritual.materials: Mars kamea, red candle, bloodstone or garnet, basil, water, incense, and a symbol of release.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what is complete, what is ready to be released, and how the higher expression of Scorpio can be embodied without rejecting Taurus.

journalPrompt: What am I ready to release from the shadow of Scorpio, and what balance with Taurus is asking to be lived now?
tarotPrompt: What truth is this Scorpio Full Moon revealing that I can no longer avoid?
